}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 green [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantains]], mashed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tsp freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 serrano [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile]], seeded and [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut]] or [[Cookbook:Rapeseed Oil|canola oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep-frying]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine plantains, salt, black pepper, the chile, and garlic. Shape into rounds about the size of a thin slice of potato.
#Heat oil to 375°F. Add rounds, 6–8 at a time, and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] until golden brown and crispy on the outside.
#Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]] set above a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]], and season immediately with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#Serve warm or room temperature.
